chromeos-config: Initial JSON support for config Added initial support for the JSON config format. Note from Simon: With this implementation we use either JSON or DTB but not both, controlled by a 'USE=json' flag. This allows the two to be developed in parallel without poluting the code with either other's internals. For example the .dtb implementation includes code to follow phandles which will not be needed with JSON, since these are expanded out on the host side.
